nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs ESLint, TypeScript type checking, Vitest tests, and database migrations in parallel before a final Next.js production build; triggered on PRs targeting main or dev and supports manual dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: The migrate job uses a pgvector/pgvector:pg17 service container with health checks to validate migrations against a live Postgres instance before the build runs. The build job is gated on all four preceding jobs via needs: [lint, typecheck, test, migrate].

nodes.name: Lint
nodes.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs ESLint to enforce code style rules.

nodes.name: Type Check
nodes.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs tsc --noEmit to validate TypeScript types across the project.

nodes.name: Tests
nodes.summary: CI job that installs Node 20 dependencies and runs the Vitest test suite.

nodes.name: Migrations
nodes.summary: CI job that spins up a pgvector Postgres 17 service container and runs node-pg-migrate to validate all pending database migrations before the build.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Final CI job gated on lint, typecheck, tests, and migrations that produces a Next.js production build using the NEXTAUTH_SECRET repository secret.
